HOW ASCII ART WORKS

Turn images
into ASCII art.

ASCII art recreates an image using text characters like . : + # @. Each character represents a different brightness, forming the shapes, shading, and detail you see.

Convert photos, animated GIFs, or videos. Keep their original colors or choose your own, adjust the detail, and export an image, animation, video, or plain text.
